PLAN "12-Week General Strength (Post-Lumbar Herniation Safe)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build whole-body strength safely without heavy spinal loading"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation and Motor Control" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Push/Pull A":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x20..30 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower Body (Hip Hinge Emphasis, No Axial Load)":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          step_up 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Upper Push/Pull B":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..30 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 3m
